observations: Chest freezer with stainless-steel/metallic lid and white painted body.
A blue sticker on the front reads '3 YEARS WARRANTY', '120 HOURS COOLING RETENTION' with generic icons (hand, snowflake, thumbs-up) and a faint 'Posted on Jiji Kicks' watermark overlay.
No brand name, logo, or model number is legible anywhere on the unit.
A round thermostat dial and small control knobs are visible on the lower front panel.
Compressor/condenser unit visible at the bottom right rear corner.
Unit sits on bare, stained concrete floor; no power cable, socket, or plug shown; no indicator light or frost/cold visible inside (lid is closed).
Some surface staining/marks on the white body near the bottom left.

read_from: photo 0 - sticker text only shows warranty/cooling claims, no brand or model legible

claims.evidence: No capacity label, nameplate, or size reference visible in photo 0.
No rating plate or spec sticker showing voltage range is visible.
This text appears on a printed marketing sticker in photo 0, but it is a manufacturer-style claim on a sticker, not a demonstrated test result.
No photo shows the unit powered on, plugged in, running, or with frost/cold air inside; lid is closed in the only photo.

risks.proof: A video clip of the unit plugged in, running, with audible compressor hum and a thermometer or frost forming inside after some minutes.

risks.risk: Actual internal capacity could be smaller than claimed 250L
risks.proof: A photo of the interior with a tape measure, or a visible capacity nameplate/rating label.
risks.if_unproven: priced at a conservative/smaller capacity tier

risks.risk: Door seal/gasket could be damaged, causing poor cooling retention
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lid gasket all around, and a photo of the lid fully open showing interior condition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a worn or faulty seal

risks.risk: Rust or corrosion under the painted surface, especially near the base and compressor area
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lower body edges, feet, and compressor housing.

risks.risk: Unknown age/usage history despite a warranty sticker that may not be from the actual original purchase
risks.proof: Photo of original receipt, warranty card, or purchase date matching the sticker claim.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with unknown history

proof_requests: Video of the freezer plugged in and running, showing compressor sound and cooling after 15-20 minutes.
Photo of the open interior showing shelves/baskets, condition, and any visible capacity/rating nameplate.
Close-up photo of the door gasket/seal all the way around.
Close-up photos of the rear compressor unit and underside for rust or damage.
A clear photo or crop of any manufacturer nameplate (brand, model, voltage, capacity) usually found on the back or inside the lid.
response.reason: This is clearly identifiable as a standard chest freezer by type, so it can be priced at worst case (unproven working condition, unverified capacity) even though no brand/model is legible and no functional proof is shown.
